description: This PHP script generates an autoload file for vendor libraries based on composer.json files found in the vendor directories. It reads composer.json files, extracts autoload configurations (psr-4, psr-0, classmap, files), and generates PHP code to register autoloaders accordingly.

methods.name: oc_generate_vendor
methods.description: Main function that scans vendor directories for composer.json files and generates a PHP autoload script based on their autoload configurations.
